# HTheme

> A scoped theme island. CSS variables flow through Vue trees, native slots, and shadow roots.

[Start with the Hearth UI agent index](../../../llms.txt). This reference describes repository source; package.json version: 0.2.0. Match it to the source/release you are using.

## Identity

- Vue export: `HTheme` from `@samishal1998/hearth-ui`.
- Custom element: `<hearth-theme>`.
- Individual constructor: `HearthThemeElement` from `@samishal1998/hearth-ui/elements`.
- Category: Foundation.
- [Implementation](https://github.com/samishal1998/hearth-ui/blob/main/src/components/HTheme.vue).

## Choose and use it correctly

- Use one theme island around an application or a deliberately different section. Do not wrap every component in another theme: a new island establishes its own preset values.
- Modes are dark, light, or system; system follows CSS media preferences. Comfortable and compact densities use 44px and 40px main controls.
- CSS custom properties inherit across shadow roots and native slots. Override --h-* tokens through the tokens property, an ancestor, or a host style. Use themeStyle() to filter a token object and themeCSS() to serialize trusted CSS values.

## Public API

theme: string = sunset · mode: dark | light | system · density: comfortable | compact · tokens: ThemeTokens

A `?` marks optional source props. A prop with a default may be omitted even when the source type is required. Internal `formDisabled` and `control-sync` plumbing is excluded below; do not use it in application code.

```ts
type Props = {
    theme?: string;
    mode?: Mode;
    density?: Density;
    tokens?: ThemeTokens;
};
```

### Defaults

```ts
{ theme: "sunset", mode: "dark", density: "comfortable" }
```

### Events

None

Vue-emitted custom-element events expose arguments as `event.detail`, an array. Listen directly on the element. Native DOM events such as `click` keep their normal payloads.

### Slots

default

Vue uses `<template #slotName>`; custom elements use `<div slot="slotName">`. Custom elements do not support Vue scoped slots.

### CSS parts

base

Use `hearth-theme::part(part-name)` for an exposed part, or inherited `--h-*` tokens for system-level styling. Native Vue components use the shared stylesheet and `h-*` classes.

## Supporting types

```ts
export type Mode = "dark" | "light" | "system";

export type Density = "comfortable" | "compact";

export type ThemeTokens = Partial<Record<`--h-${string}`, string>>;
```

## Vue example

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { HTheme, HButton } from '@samishal1998/hearth-ui';
import '@samishal1998/hearth-ui/styles.css';

</script>

<template>
  <HTheme theme="sunset" mode="dark" :tokens="{ '--h-accent': '#ff7a2f' }">
    <HButton variant="primary">Save</HButton>
  </HTheme>
</template>
```

## Web-component example

Provide a mount point (use a `form` instead of `div` when demonstrating field submission):

```html
<div id="example"></div>
```

The following is bundler-based ESM. For raw HTML, load `dist/themes.css` with a stylesheet link and import `registerElements` from `./dist/elements/index.js` instead. Set array/object properties before connection when they should become reset defaults.

```js
import { registerElements } from '@samishal1998/hearth-ui/elements';
import '@samishal1998/hearth-ui/themes.css';
registerElements();

const mount = document.querySelector('#example');
const element = document.createElement('hearth-theme');
Object.assign(element, {
  "theme": "sunset",
  "mode": "dark",
  "tokens": {
    "--h-accent": "#ff7a2f"
  }
});
element.innerHTML = "<hearth-button variant=\"primary\">Save</hearth-button>"; // Static example markup only; never inject untrusted HTML.
mount.append(element);
```

## Theme token reference

```css
/* Sunset is the default. Set these attributes on html or a theme island. */
:root,
[data-hearth-theme] {
  color-scheme: dark;
  --h-bg: #0b1220;
  --h-surface: #101a2b;
  --h-raised: #111c2d;
  --h-panel: rgba(16, 26, 43, 0.84);
  --h-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.09);
  --h-border-strong: #536177;
  --h-text: #f7f8fb;
  --h-muted: #aeb8ca;
  --h-faint: #91a0b6;
  --h-accent: #ff7a2f;
  --h-accent-hover: #ffb15c;
  --h-accent-text: #ffb15c;
  --h-on-accent: #24160f;
  --h-accent-subtle: color-mix(in srgb, var(--h-accent) 10%, transparent);
  --h-success: #24c978;
  --h-warning: #f4b21a;
  --h-danger: #ff8290;
  --h-info: #86b8f5;
  --h-focus: var(--h-accent-text);
  --h-focus-width: 2px;
  --h-font:
    Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont,
    "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
  --h-font-mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace;
  --h-font-size: 14px;
  --h-radius-control: 10px;
  --h-radius-card: 16px;
  --h-radius-panel: 20px;
  --h-radius-pill: 999px;
  --h-space: 4px;
  --h-control-height: 44px;
  --h-control-padding: 16px;
  --h-card-padding: 24px;
  --h-page-padding: clamp(20px, 3vw, 40px);
  --h-sidebar-width: 232px;
  --h-sidebar-height: 420px;
  --h-progress-height: 8px;
  --h-separator-space: 20px;
  --h-content-max: 1440px;
  --h-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.18);
  --h-shadow-soft: 0 4px 14px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1);
  --h-motion: 150ms;
  --h-scene-bg: linear-gradient(145deg, #162338, #0d1727 65%, #292934);
  --h-scene-text: #f7f8fb;
  --h-scene-muted: #b5bfd1;
  --h-mountain-back: #485064;
  --h-mountain-mid: #1a2c44;
  --h-mountain-front: #0b1424;
}

}

}

  --h-accent-text: #28603c;

  --h-bg: #f6f4fb;

  --h-accent-text: #61428f;

  --h-bg: #fbf4f6;
  --h-faint: #626f85;

  --h-danger: #a63e16;

@media (prefers-color-scheme: light) {
  [data-hearth-mode="system"] {
    color-scheme: light;
    --h-bg: #f4f7fb;
    --h-surface: #fff;
    --h-raised: #fff;
    --h-panel: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
    --h-border: rgba(18, 31, 52, 0.13);

    --h-warning: #886211;
    --h-danger: #b02e40;
    --h-info: #245f9d;
    --h-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgb(38 51 77 / 0.08);
    --h-shadow-soft: 0 3px 14px rgb(38 51 77 / 0.05);
  }
  [data-hearth-theme="ocean"][data-hearth-mode="system"] {
    --h-bg: #f2f7fb;
    --h-accent-text: #185689;
  }
  [data-hearth-theme="forest"][data-hearth-mode="system"] {
    --h-bg: #f3f7f2;
    --h-accent-text: #28603c;
  }
  [data-hearth-theme="dusk"][data-hearth-mode="system"] {
    --h-bg: #f6f4fb;
    --h-faint: #626f85;
    --h-accent-text: #61428f;
  }
  [data-hearth-theme="rose"][data-hearth-mode="system"] {

  }
}
[data-hearth-density="compact"] {
  --h-control-height: 40px;
```
